title: Update Gen 4 & Gen 5 Mgp licence format to require 'Mgp-' prefix + alphanumeric

requirements.text: Update the MGP validation logic so the accepted format is exactly the prefix "Mgp-" (capital M, then gp, then hyphen) followed by one or more letters and/or numbers (A–Z, a–z, 0–9).

quotes: can i get for the enter mgp licence for both the gen 4 and gen 5 make it exatly say Mgp with a capital M and - and then any numbers or letters

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/lib/mgp.ts, validateMgpId returns true for values like "Mgp-1", "Mgp-ABC", "Mgp-a1B2".
validateMgpId returns false for values like "mgp-123" (wrong case), "MGP-123" (wrong case), "Mgp-" (missing suffix), "Mgp-12_3" (underscore not allowed), and "Mgp 123" (missing hyphen).
getMgpErrorMessage reflects the updated rule (prefix "Mgp-" + letters/numbers) and no longer mentions "mgp-" or "digits only".

requirements.text: Update the Gen 4 (ELC options) Mgp entry UI to refer to "Mgp licence" and show the required format using the exact prefix "Mgp-" in user-facing text (title/description/label/placeholder/error).

quotes: for the enter mgp licence for both the gen 4 ... make it exatly say Mgp with a capital M and -

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/pages/Gen4ElcOptions.tsx, the dialog title/description/label text uses "Mgp licence" (English) rather than "Mgp ID".
The input placeholder/example shown to the user uses "Mgp-" (e.g., "Mgp-ABC123"), matching the new validation rule.
Submitting an invalid value shows the updated error message from getMgpErrorMessage.

requirements.text: Update the Gen 5 options Mgp entry UI to refer to "Mgp licence" and show the required format using the exact prefix "Mgp-" in user-facing text (title/description/label/placeholder/error).

quotes: ... for both the gen 4 and gen 5 ... Mgp with a capital M and - and then any numbers or letters

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/pages/Gen5Options.tsx, the dialog title/description/label text uses "Mgp licence" (English) rather than "Mgp ID".
The input placeholder/example shown to the user uses "Mgp-" (e.g., "Mgp-ABC123"), matching the new validation rule.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Keep the backend as-is (no new canisters/services; single-actor architecture unchanged).
nonGoals: Adding backend persistence or server-side verification for Mgp licences.
Changing checkout flow, pricing, or adding new product models.
